subject: Residency erasures: sampling plan, logs, and deliverables for SOC 2/ISO audit
messages:
From: Jane Smith <jane.smith@midlandbank.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@midlandbank.com
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: sampling & deletion evidence for upcoming SOC 2 attestation

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Midland Bank's external assessor (TrustAssure) has asked us to provide a sampling of residency and erasure evidence tied to your tenant lifecycle controls as part of our SOC 2 scope. Specifically they're asking for: 

- A short sampling plan that defines tenant selection methodology, date ranges, and sample size.
- Export of deletion/erasure logs for the sampled tenants (including timestamps, initiating service account, and confirmation hashes).
- Mapping between tenant IDs, geographic residency, and retention TTL configuration used at the time of deletion.

Can Redwood provide a draft sampling plan and a set of sample logs for 3 tenants (one EU, one US, one APAC)? If possible we'd like the artifacts by EOD Monday so TrustAssure can incorporate them in their control testing later next week.

Appreciate a quick confirmation of scope and ETA.

Best,
Jane Smith
Senior Security Manager, Midland Bank

Attachments: none
From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Smith <jane.smith@midlandbank.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: sampling & deletion evidence for upcoming SOC 2 attestation

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear ask. We can support the sampling and will provide the artifacts you listed. High level plan we propose: 

- Sampling approach: stratified random sample across three geozones (EU/US/APAC) with priority for tenants that exercised deletion in the last 90 days.
- Deliverables: (1) sampling plan spreadsheet, (2) CSV of deletion events with hashes and actor IDs, (3) TTL & residency mapping snapshot, (4) short runbook describing how the logs were derived.
- ETA: draft sampling plan and initial sample logs by 2026-11-06 17:00 PST. Finalized deliverables by 2026-11-09 if TrustAssure requires additional cross-checks.

I've attached the sampling plan draft for your review (residency-sampling-plan.xlsx). Marcus and Laura — can you validate the log export columns and include chain-of-custody hashes in the CSV? Vanessa, please add the mapping snapshot to the shared folder once it's exported.

If that timeline works for Midland & TrustAssure we'll proceed. Happy to hop on a quick call to align.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: residency-sampling-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:10:00 -08:00
Subject: INTERNAL: quick alignment — sample export format and TTL mapping

Marcus/Laura,

Quick request — Midland asked for deletion events that include: tenant_id, deletion_timestamp (UTC), initiating_principal, object_type (e.g. model_checkpoint, user_data, logs), residency_region, retention_policy_id, TTL_seconds_at_deletion, and SHA256 confirmation hash. They want chain-of-custody traceability (who initiated the deletion and when).

Can you: 
- Produce a CSV with the columns above for three tenants (EU/US/APAC) pulled from 2026-08-01 to 2026-11-01.
- Include a short notes column describing whether deletion was automated (TTL) or manual.
- Attach the computation method for the SHA256 hash used to confirm artifact immutability in the sampling_plan file.

We are targeting a draft back to Midland by close of day Friday (11/6). If you expect any blockers, flag them by EOD today.

— Grace
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 07:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: quick alignment — sample export format and TTL mapping

Grace — pulling these now. A few implementation notes and decisions we made while extracting the sample: 

- Sample method: stratified random selection from tenants with deletion events between 2026-08-01 and 2026-11-01. We tagged each tenant with residency based on the account's pinned geozone at deletion time.
- Hashing: we compute SHA256 over the exported artifact payload (UTF-8 canonical JSON for metadata rows) then produce a hex digest. Column name in CSV: confirmation_hash_sha256.
- Chain-of-custody: deletion events include the service account (redwood-deleter@redwood-managed) or an admin principal (e.g., laura_bennett@redwood.ai) when deletions were manual. We'll include both principal_id and principal_email columns.
- TTL mapping: attached a short TTL playbook and the sample CSV (erase-log-sample.csv). TTLs are stored in retention_policy table at deletion time; we snapshot the retention_policy_id and TTL_seconds_at_deletion.

Known limitations: backup snapshot deletion workflow (offline archival) is tracked separately and is out of scope for this sample unless Midland specifically requests backups.

Deliverables attached: erase-log-sample.csv, redwood-ttl-playbook.pdf.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Platform Engineer — Data Lifecycle

Attachments: erase-log-sample.csv (CSV), redwood-ttl-playbook.pdf (PDF)
From: audit@trustassure.io <audit@trustassure.io>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Jane Smith <jane.smith@midlandbank.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: sampling & deletion evidence for upcoming SOC 2 attestation

Hi Grace/Jane,

Thanks for the draft artifacts. A couple of follow-ups from the assessor side: 

1) For the confirmation_hash_sha256 we need to see the canonicalization method and a short script or command line used for the hash so we can reproduce it.
2) Please include a signed timestamp (RFC 3161 or equivalent) or an internal notarization record for at least one deletion event in the sample to prove the deletion occurred at the stated time.
3) If possible, provide the tenant -> residency mapping export as a separate file (JSON or CSV) so we can cross-check geozone assignments.

If you can get the hash script and a notarized timestamp by EOD today for the sample set, that will help us avoid extending fieldwork.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Senior Auditor — TrustAssure

(Forwarded from Jane Smith for context)
